# Etehadyar website and product information

> Product marketing website with a small PHP content-management panel. This repository is not the WordPress plugin or theme implementation. Product capabilities described by the site must not be interpreted as verified capabilities of this website package.

## Identity
- Product: Etehadyar (اتحادیار), described as an AI WordPress Operating System.
- Product version described in the initial content: 6.12.0.
- Organization: EtehadWP (اتحاد وردپرس); founder named in the supplied content: Sajad Masoumi (سجاد معصومی).
- Canonical product site: https://etehadyar.ir/ (live hosting status not verified by this repository audit).

## Public content
- [Home](https://etehadyar.ir/): overview, pricing, FAQ and clearly labeled demonstrations.
- [Documentation](https://etehadyar.ir/docs/): Persian product documentation.
- [About](https://etehadyar.ir/about/): organization and product background.
- [Changelog](https://etehadyar.ir/changelog/): product history, searchable from the shared public JSON.
- [CMS content](https://etehadyar.ir/data/site_data.json): current public headline, FAQ, price, product version and releases. Do not store secrets in this file.

## Website behavior and limits
- Light is the default appearance, with an optional dark scheme. Decorative depth is a subtle pointer-parallax illusion, not a five-dimensional technology or live product functionality.
- Motion is disabled on narrow/touch-oriented devices, with reduced motion or forced colors, and while the page is hidden. There is an effects-off control.
- Public navigation and changelog filtering do not wait for CMS hydration. Expired CMS sessions preserve an exportable draft in the same tab only; it is not persisted or published automatically.
- Audio demonstrations use prerecorded local MP3s and fixed sample replies; they do not contact a live AI model. Optional browser speech recognition requires permission and may use the browser vendor's recognition service.
- Pipeline indicators are a simulation, not live queue execution or server health telemetry.
- ROI is an estimate, excluding AI API costs.
- English coverage is partial; technical pages remain Persian.
- The published product history describes voice, content generation, WooCommerce, queues, reporting and vault features. Their implementation is outside this repository and has not been validated here.

## Pricing and checkout
- Initial displayed lifetime license: 15,000,000 Toman / 150 USD; current values come from the public CMS JSON.
- Iranian structured-data currency is IRR: one Toman equals ten IRR.
- Checkout links are disabled until separate real HTTPS destinations are configured. The website is not a payment gateway and does not verify payment success.

## Deployment
- Static HTML/CSS/JS and PHP CMS; Node is development and test tooling only.
- Use maintained PHP 8.3 or newer for production. Syntax and smoke compatibility have also been checked with PHP-WASM 7.4.33, not native legacy hosting.
- No default admin account; hashed credentials and sessions must remain outside the public document root.
- HTTPS, hosting permissions, server rules and actual payment destinations require operator verification.
- Repository deployment guide: README-FA.md. Scope and automated test results: AUDIT-FULL-REPORT.md.
